observations: Purple and black steam generator iron.
Brand 'morphy richards' is visible on the handle and the base unit in photo 0.
The text 'SPEED STEAM PRO' is visible on the side of the base unit in photo 0.
The iron is resting on a grey mat on a dark car hood.
The power cord is bundled and has a braided fabric cover.
The soleplate (bottom) of the iron is not visible.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a domestic steam generator iron; it is not an industrial-grade machine.
There is no visual evidence of the device powered on or emitting steam.

risks.risk: Soleplate may be scratched, burnt, or have significant limescale buildup.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the iron's soleplate.

risks.risk: Internal pump failure or heating element malfunction.
risks.proof: A video showing the iron heating up and producing a continuous burst of steam.

risks.risk: Water tank or internal hose leaks under pressure.
risks.proof: A video of the unit pressurized with water in the tank.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification sticker on the bottom of the base.
Video showing the iron producing steam.
response.reason: The brand and model line are clearly identified, which is sufficient to provide a price based on a worst-case functional condition.
